name: Franchise
title: franchise.cloud
shortDescription: Franchise is a user-friendly SQL notebook that allows users to interact with data directly in their browser without any installation or sign-up. It supports various data formats like CSV, JSON, and XLSX, and integrates with major databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and BigQuery through a local bridge. Ideal for data analysts and developers, it provides an intuitive interface for crafting SQL queries, visualizing results, and sharing insights effectively.
pros: Supports multiple data formats and databases

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Jupyter Notebook
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Flexible and widely used for data analysis
